Why this matters for SSC

"X invented Y in year Z" is a 1–2 mark question that comes at least once per paper. The list below covers the most-asked items.

---

Frequently-confused pairs (must remember)

  • X-rays: Röntgen (1895).
  • Radium/Polonium: Marie Curie.
  • Electron: J.J. Thomson.
  • Proton: Rutherford.
  • Neutron: Chadwick.
  • Raman Effect: C.V. Raman (1928).
  • Bose-Einstein Condensate: Satyendra Nath Bose + Einstein.
  • DNA: Watson + Crick (+ Franklin, Wilkins).
  • Polio (Salk vs Sabin): Salk = injection, Sabin = oral.
  • Tuberculosis (Koch) vs Anthrax (Koch) — Koch is the doctor, both.
  • Penicillin: Fleming (1928) — but the practical clinical use is Florey, Chain, Heatley.
  • Streptomycin (TB drug): Schatz + Waksman.
  • First heart transplant: Christiaan Barnard (1967) — South Africa.
  • First kidney transplant: Joseph Murray (1954) — US.
  • First lung transplant: James Hardy (1963) — US.
  • First liver transplant: Thomas Starzl (1963) — US.
  • First test-tube baby: Louise Brown (1978) — UK; technique: IVF, Steptoe + Edwards.

Key concepts

  • Memorize: inventor + invention + year.
  • 7 key items: X-ray (Röntgen), Penicillin (Fleming), Vaccination (Jenner), Telephone (Bell), Radio (Marconi), WWW (Berners-Lee), Gravity (Newton).
  • Indian contribution: Zero, decimal, Raman Effect, Sushruta surgery, Ayurveda, Iron Pillar, Wootz steel, Chess, Yoga.

2024–2025 Updates

  • Nobel Prize 2024 (often asked in SSC GK):
  • Physics: John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton (foundations of machine learning).
  • Chemistry: David Baker, Demis Hassabis, John Jumper (computational protein design).
  • Medicine: Victor Ambros, Gary Ruvkun (microRNA — gene regulation).
  • Literature: Han Kang (South Korean; first Korean to win).
  • Peace: Nihon Hidankyo (Japanese atomic-bomb survivors — Nihon = Japan).
  • Economics: Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson, James A. Robinson (institutions & prosperity).
  • AI-related milestones (2024):
  • Nobel 2024 Physics awarded for machine learning (Hopfield + Hinton).
  • Generative AI (LLMs) — main reference: transformer architecture (Vaswani et al., Google 2017).
  • Space 2024–25:
  • Chandrayaan-3 (Aug 2023): India's 1st soft landing on Moon's south pole. (2023 update, carry-over 2024.)
  • Aditya-L1 (Sep 2023): India's 1st solar observatory.
  • Gaganyaan TV-D1 (Oct 2023, uncrewed): test flight; TV-D2 followed in 2024.
  • XPoSat (Jan 2024): India's 1st polarimetry X-ray astronomy satellite.
  • INSAT-3DS (Feb 2024): advanced weather satellite.
  • Medical / Biotech 2024:
  • GLP-1 drugs (semaglutide, tirzepatide) for diabetes / weight loss — breakthrough therapy class.
  • CRISPR-based Casgevy (2023) — first CRISPR gene-editing therapy approved (UK + US).
  • Indian contributions still relevant:
  • C.V. Raman (Raman Effect, 1928) — still asked.
  • S.N. Bose (Bose-Einstein statistics) — still asked.
  • Sushruta (plastic surgery, ~600 BC) — still asked.
  • Brahmagupta (zero as a number, 628 AD) — still asked.
No major "first invention" in 2024–25 has been added to standard SSC syllabus. Lock in the canonical list above.
